title: Cost Management
duration: 45 hours of lectures + 105 hours of self-study

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and recognize basic concepts about cost and business cost, as well as the principles of calculating business costs.
Understand and recognize methods of calculating business costs by type, point, and object.
Understand and master the tasks of cost management and how to use cost information combined with other information to help managers make decisions.
Understand and master the basic issues related to planning, evaluation, and control of business operations costs.
Understand and master the basic issues related to evaluating and controlling the results of cost management.
Students have independent work skills, communication skills, presentation skills, creative thinking, critical thinking.
Students have group work skills, dynamic and diverse.
Skills to handle data, synthesize, and solve problems.
Students have the ability to independently study, accumulate, and improve professional knowledge, adapt to different working environments, and be autonomous in their work.
Awareness of social responsibility, professional ethics, and civic responsibility.
